spec.description: IoSAR Bridge Structural Health Monitoring — v0.3 (per-PS metrics, split panels)

spec.query:
from(bucket: "iosar")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "uplink")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] == "gb-sar-01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "dominant_frequency_hz")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "iosar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "uplink")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] == "gb-sar-01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "dominant_frequency_hz")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "dominant_frequency_hz")

from(bucket: "iosar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "uplink")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] == "gb-sar-01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "dominant_frequency_hz_2")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "dominant_frequency_hz_2")

spec.description: Dominant frequency per PS point (PS0–PS4). Series only appear if the PS point exists.
spec.title: Per-PS Dominant Frequency

spec.query:
p0 = from(bucket: "iosar") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "uplink") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] == "gb-sar-01") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "rms_ps1") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, position_m: -10.5336, label: "PierLeft", displacement_mm: -r._value }))

p1 = from(bucket: "iosar") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "uplink") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] == "gb-sar-01") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "rms_ps3") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, position_m: -7.0213, label: "MidLeft", displacement_mm: -r._value }))

p2 = from(bucket: "iosar") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "uplink") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] == "gb-sar-01") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "rms_ps2") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, position_m: -3.2996, label: "MidSpan", displacement_mm: -r._value }))

p3 = from(bucket: "iosar") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "uplink") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] == "gb-sar-01") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "rms_ps4") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, position_m: 2.1224, label: "MidRight", displacement_mm: -r._value }))

p4 = from(bucket: "iosar") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "uplink") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_id"] == "gb-sar-01") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "rms_ps0") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, position_m: 5.6929, label: "PierRight", displacement_mm: -r._value }))

union(tables: [p0, p1, p2, p3, p4])
  |> sort(columns: ["position_m"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "position_m", "label", "displacement_mm"])

from(bucket: "iosar")
